name: Belching / Burping
description: Belching, during sexual intercourse, or just as an act during the roleplay. May be exaggerated (visible expulsions of air) and / or with exaggerated burping noises, but not necessarily.

name: Dirty Feet
description: Expresses an interest in feet that are deemed “unclean,” usually through sweat, dirt, or a buildup of grime.

name: Extreme Musk
description: Engaging in an RP in which one character exudes exceptionally strong odors from the body, such as but not limited to: odor from the crotch, foreskin, feet, or armpits. Indicates a level of body odor that is typically unrealistic and / or visibly apparent in the form of a radiating fog.

name: Farting
description: Farting, during sexual intercourse, or just as an act during the roleplay. May be exaggerated (visible expulsions of air) and / or with exaggerated flatulent noises, but not necessarily.

name: Filth
description: Expresses an interest in the inclusion of dirtiness and uncleanly aspects such as foul odors, trash, or any other form of physical matter that is considered unsanitary or disgusting.

name: Messy
description: Engaging in an RP that may involve excessive amounts of liquids (which may be bodily fluids) or other solutions such as (but not limited to) mud, food, slime, etc.

name: Slob
description: Characters without hygiene or uncaring of typical standards for cleanliness due to laziness, personal choice, or otherwise; may emphasize and derive pleasure from laziness or from actions linked with a lack of hygiene.

name: Smegma
description: Expresses an interest in the build-up substance that generates on one's genitals (typically under foreskin and labia) due to a lack of maintained hygiene.

name: Swallowing Vomit
description: Engaging in an RP in which a character will orally consume vomit.

name: Unwashed Musk
description: Refers to an RP involving characters where the aspect of unwashed musk is notably present / involved in play. Generally implies one or more characters having a distinct scent due to a lack of hygiene (typically with pheromones derived from the crotch).

name: Vomiting
description: The act of vomiting, being vomited upon, consuming vomit or otherwise including vomit in the sexual context of an RP.
